decision_policy: Highest duration-weighted full-song objective score from actual binaural section outputs. No subjective promotion, no recency bonus, and no forced 360 musical motion.
epistemic_limits: Scores remain engineering proxies rather than human perceptual probabilities.
Front/back and elevation classification on musical native-stereo stems are domain-shifted relative to controlled probe calibration.
The full-song winner is still not a mastered or release-approved file. Independent winner QA is required next.
